description: Expected results for the official mosartwmpy tutorial case: CONUS 1/8-degree NLDAS grid (224 x 464 cells), 1981-05-01 to 1981-05-30, 3-hour step, water management with ISTARF reservoir release. Inputs are the unmodified official tutorial data (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6959736) and the official notebooks/config.yaml. The case ships no official reference output, so the expected values were recorded from real runs on this server. Two full runs gave exactly the same values for every check.
engine_version: mosartwmpy 0.6.2 (PyPI wheel) in /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/MOSART/venv (Python 3.12, pandas 3.0.3, numpy 2.4.6, numba)

recorded_with: run_reference.py --print-values, run twice: identical values (bit for bit) in both runs
reference: own run (no official reference output exists for the tutorial)
notes: Run settings made only inside run_reference.py: (1) pandas option future.infer_string=False when pandas >= 3, needed or mosartwmpy 0.6.2 stops in the first step (ISTARF, 'operands could not be broadcast together with shapes (103936,) (80053,)'); (2) NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 so the run repeats exactly.

Proof the pandas setting does not change numbers: with ISTARF turned off (the only setting where the run works without the pandas setting), runs with and without it gave bit-identical output and restart files (one thread).

With many numba threads the model is not bit-repeatable: domain totals moved by about 1e-4 (routing) to 1e-3 (water management) between two runs. The tolerance 1e-6 relative is meant for the one-thread run.
